mapper.select: SELECT q.id,q.owner_id,q.status,current_version.id AS current_version_id,v.id AS version_id, v.prompt_json,v.reference_answer,v.checkpoints_json FROM question q JOIN question_version v ON v.owner_id=q.owner_id AND v.question_id=q.id LEFT JOIN question_version current_version ON current_version.owner_id=q.owner_id AND current_version.question_id=q.id AND current_version.id=q.current_version_id WHERE q.owner_id=#{owner} AND q.id=#{id} AND v.id=#{versionId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_exposure WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND question_id=#{questionId} AND version_id=#{versionId} AND exposure_kind='REFERENCE_VIEW')

SELECT i.id,i.owner_id,i.kind,i.status,i.current_version_id,v.id AS version_id,v.body, current_version.body AS current_body FROM knowledge_item i LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=#{versionId} LEFT JOIN knowledge_version current_version ON current_version.owner_id=i.owner_id AND current_version.item_id=i.id AND current_version.id=i.current_version_id WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{id}
SELECT id,owner_id,status,sha256 FROM material_attachment WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
